messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: Rmarkdown V2 --> Jekyll
parts:
Hello.

I was wondering how to use rmarkdown::render function to produce a jekyll "friendly" md document?

In the past, Jason C Fisher had provided  a function on his blog "KnitPost" that would do the trick and keep the yaml part in the rmd file unchanged? 

Is there a format in new render function (part of rmarkdown) that would do the same thing?

Thanks in advance and excuse my limited knowledge of knitr, markdown, and rmarkdown packages

messages.author: d15046068811b17e
messages.subject: Re: Rmarkdown V2 --> Jekyll
parts:
If you use knitr you can just call:

render_jekyll()

before you knit the document. If you call the rmarkdown render function than you should specify it as a knitr option. in addition, make sure that your output is markdown not html when you use render
